statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-5260 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-10): for a server using an RSA key backed by a PKCS#11 token, a client sending an extremely short premaster secret during an RSA or RSA-PSK key exchange could trigger a short heap overread. It was reported as https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/issues/1814 . GnuTLS fixed it in 3.8.13 with commit 77228f2d1ac207d2f894e5a168fbb47e5378e42f (lib/auth/rsa: check that ciphertext matches the modulus size), which makes the server reject a ciphertext whose length differs from the key's modulus size in lib/auth/rsa.c and lib/auth/rsa_psk.c, and with commit cf6bdc5e4df49e5583d3fb4d2296779785f10683 (lib/pkcs11_privkey: guard against overreading on short ciphertexts) on the callee side: https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/77228f2d1ac207d2f894e5a168fbb47e5378e42f, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/cf6bdc5e4df49e5583d3fb4d2296779785f10683, https://gnutls.org/security-new.html, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/blob/3.8.13/NEWS . Alpine's 3.23-stable gnutls APKBUILD builds gnutls from the upstream release and lists CVE-2026-5260 under its 3.8.13-r0 security fixes: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/gnutls/APKBUILD . We downloaded every package built from the gnutls source in the Alpine 3.23 main index of the DHI Alpine repository as listed on 2026-11-28: gnutls, gnutls-c++, gnutls-dbg, gnutls-dev, gnutls-doc and gnutls-utils, each at 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0, 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 for x86_64 and aarch64, 48 apks, and checked each download against its index checksum. The library code is in libgnutls.so.30 in the gnutls package, a dynamically linked shared library whose needed libraries include musl's C library and libp11-kit.so.0, so PKCS#11 support is built in. gnutls-c++ ships the C++ wrapper libgnutlsxx.so.30, which links libgnutls.so.30; gnutls-utils ships seven programs (certtool, gnutls-cli, gnutls-cli-debug, gnutls-serv, ocsptool, p11tool and psktool), each dynamically linked against libgnutls.so.30 and loaded by the musl dynamic loader; gnutls-dev ships headers, gnutls.pc and the libgnutls.so and libgnutlsxx.so symbolic links; gnutls-doc ships man pages, info manuals and text documentation; gnutls-dbg ships separate debug-symbol files for the two libraries and the seven programs. None of the 48 packages contains a static archive, a PE file or a Mach-O file. The GnuTLS version string in libgnutls.so.30 reads 3.8.11, 3.8.12, 3.8.13 and 3.8.14 in the matching builds on both architectures. We disassembled the RSA and RSA-PSK client key exchange handlers (proc_rsa_client_kx and _gnutls_proc_rsa_psk_client_kx) in libgnutls.so.30 of every build, locating them with the gnutls-dbg symbols: in 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 each calls gnutls_privkey_get_pk_algorithm once to read the key size for the new length check, and in 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0 neither calls it, on both architectures. So 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0 are affected and 3.8.13-r0 is the first fixed build; 3.8.14-r0 also carries the fix.

CVE-2026-5260: a remote attacker sending an extremely short premaster secret in an RSA key exchange to a GnuTLS server whose RSA key is held on a PKCS#11 token could trigger a short heap over-read. Upstream advisory GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-10 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html#GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-10, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/issues/1814) was fixed in GnuTLS 3.8.13 by https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/77228f2d1ac207d2f894e5a168fbb47e5378e42f and https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/cf6bdc5e4df49e5583d3fb4d2296779785f10683. Debian fixed it for trixie in gnutls28 3.8.9-3+deb13u4 (DSA-6281-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-5260), which applies the 3.8.13 security patch set to 3.8.9. The only build of this owner currently published for Debian 13 is made from that Debian version; the changelog shipped in its libgnutls30t64 package on amd64 and arm64 records this CVE. The range ends at that build, the lowest published version carrying the fix. Builds made from Debian's earlier 3.8.9-3+deb13u2 and 3.8.9-3+deb13u3 sources sort below it and are reported as affected.
